nfl_standard_under_3leg_flex.gate: L5=5, L10>=8, directional D (UNDER vs Elite or Above Avg)
nfl_standard_under_3leg_flex.breakeven_uses: The N-correct Flex quote scraped on slips that contain these legs. The published 3x for 3/3 and 1x for 2/3 stays the bar only until that scrape exists.
promotion_requires_all: At least 100 decided legs whose slate date is after 2026-10-11.
Those legs come from several NFL weeks and several players.
Wilson 95% lower bound at or above the per-leg breakeven of the real scraped Flex quote.
The four cells found by scanning every gated cell do not count toward the 100.

Rule 4 applies to NFL as written, both directions. Lines 0.5, 2.5, and 4.5 are out when role_tier is SUPPORT. PRIMARY and SECONDARY on those lines may count. A fragile line with no role_tier does not count until role is known.
nfl_standard_under_3leg_flex.face_label_caveat: Label-based. The 10-11 Standard UNDER cells and the rule-4-for-NFL ruling were computed on pick_type that step1 never stored (defaulted to Standard downstream); Demon/Goblin rungs are mixed into the 'Standard' rows. Only slate dates with step1 pick_type persisted (2026-10-23+, plus 09-20/09-21/09-24) are real faces. Forward counting must use utils.face_ladder status == verified. See data/reports/face_contamination_2026-10-24.md.

rule4.face_label_caveat: The sacks UNDER 0.5 fragility example and the ungated hit rate this ruling cites were read from label-only Standard rows (see face_label_caveat). Re-read on verified faces before relying on either.
rule4.why: Rule 4 caps miss-by-1 tail risk. A sacks UNDER 0.5 loses on one sack, the same fragility the rule was written for on OVERs. The ungated hit rate does not waive it.

goblin70_on_2x_plus.shape: Goblin Power quoted at 2x or more
promotion_requires_all: At least 100 decided legs whose slate date is after 2026-10-11.
Those legs come from several weeks and several players.
Each quote is stored at scrape time with standard_line, the Goblin-to-Standard gap, and Goblin-70 status.
The hit rate is graded on those 2x-plus slips' own legs, not the pooled Goblin-70 sleeve.
Wilson 95% lower bound at or above the per-leg breakeven of that slip's own quote.
